info.title: FindBack Claims API
info.description: Design proposal dated 2026-11-14; not implemented or team approved. Shapes authoritative here; permission/state rules in claims-contract.md must be updated together. UUID, Post mapping, version migration, Return workflow, text-only evidence, no default admin override and retry policy require integration agreement. All operations require active authenticated user. Actor comes from token; client actor/status/role fields forbidden. Unknown query parameters return 422; only listMyClaims accepts declared queries. JSON objects reject unknown properties. Strings are trimmed before length validation. Responses including errors are no-store. State invariants and lock order Post -> Claim -> Return: companion contract.

tags.name: Claims
tags.description: Private ownership verification and receipt confirmation.

post.description: Active user, visible FOUND post accepting claims, actor != owner. Actor comes from token. Atomically create PENDING claim, text evidence, audit and outbox. Duplicate active claim per claimant/post is 409. New ID after REJECTED allowed only if post remains eligible. One APPROVED/RETURNED winner per post. No uploads or file paths. Business rules: claims-contract.md sections 2, 4, 6.

patch.description: Associated FOUND post owner AND actor != claimant. Admin role alone grants no permission. PENDING only; expected_version must match; evidence required. Post must be eligible with no other APPROVED/RETURNED winner. Set decision metadata and increment version. Do not create Return or close post. Keep competing PENDING claims unchanged. Repeated PATCH after transition is 409. No query parameters.

patch.description: Only claimant; owner/admin cannot confirm on their behalf. APPROVED claim, matching expected_version, receipt_confirmed=true, existing Return HANDED_OVER. Resolve Return by claim_id. Atomically confirm Return, mark Claim RETURNED with matching actor/time, increment version, close FOUND post, audit and outbox. Roll back all on any failure. Do not fabricate Return or skip stages. Deleted/moderated/inconsistent Post returns POST_STATE_CONFLICT. Repeat is 409, no duplicate events. Arrangement/hand-over APIs are external dependencies beyond these six endpoints. No query parameters.
